name: CrustAPI
description: People Refresh, public LinkedIn profiles, companies, posts, jobs and people search, plus Google Maps and Search. LinkedIn data uses public, logged-out sources. Returned fields vary by record. Wallet accounts use prepaid USD funds at each deposit’s saved endpoint rates. Eligible accounts receive $6 of free usage monthly; paid funds never expire. Empty and failed results are uncharged. Use explicit USD billing fields for accounting. See https://crustapi.com/docs and https://crustapi.com/pricing.
